Job Description

Sr Tower Lead (Support & Operations)

| Chennai, Tamil NaduBengaluru, Karnataka

Job Summary

Mainframe Network 

Role Summary

Responsible for the administration, support, maintenance, and optimization of IBM Mainframe network infrastructure, ensuring secure, stable, and high-performing connectivity between mainframe systems, distributed platforms, applications, and external networks. The role supports business-critical production environments and drives continuous improvement, automation, and operational excellence.

Technical Skills Required

Mandatory

  • IBM z/OS
  • VTAM
  • TCP/IP for z/OS
  • SNA Networking
  • OSA Configuration
  • NCP Concepts
  • JES2/JES3 Connectivity
  • TSO/ISPF
  • RACF Security Basics
  • SDSF
  • Network Diagnostics and Tracing

Preferred

  • NetView
  • System Automation
  • MQ
  • CICS Connectivity
  • FTP/SFTP
  • Connect:Direct
  • SSL/TLS Certificates
  • Network Performance Tuning
  • Mainframe Automation Tools
  • Disaster Recovery Processes

Experience Levels

Associate General Manager / Lead (E4.2-E5.1)

  • 10+ years in Mainframe Infrastructure
  • 5+ years in Mainframe Networking
  • Expertise in VTAM/TCP-IP architecture
  • Client-facing delivery experience
  • Team leadership and technical governance
  • Transformation and modernization exposure

Soft Skills

  • Stakeholder Management
  • Client Communication
  • Incident Management
  • Problem Solving
  • Leadership and Mentoring
  • Documentation and Governance
  • Continuous Improvement Mindset

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Administer and support VTAM, TCP/IP, and SNA network environments.
  • Configure and maintain mainframe communication resources and network definitions.
  • Monitor network performance, availability, and capacity utilization.
  • Troubleshoot network connectivity issues impacting CICS, MQ, IMS, DB2, and batch workloads.
  • Perform incident, problem, and change management activities.
  • Coordinate with distributed network, security, storage, and infrastructure teams.
  • Implement network-related software upgrades, maintenance, and vulnerability remediation.
  • Support disaster recovery, business continuity, and infrastructure resilience initiatives.
  • Develop and maintain operational documentation, runbooks, and standard operating procedures.
  • Drive automation and process improvements to enhance service quality and reduce manual effort.
  • Participate in on-call support and critical production issue resolution.
  • Ensure compliance with security, audit, and regulatory requirements.
